<@709464912904323072> Thank you so much for the wonderful event. Your thoughtful hospitality made the participants feel completely at ease.
When you played the demo saying, “This is how it sounds in Japanese,” and the news was read in Chinese, your spontaneous joke—”This is Japanese with a very heavy Chinese dialect!”—was absolutely brilliant. The whole room was filled with laughter. It was a truly wonderful time throughout the event. Thank you again.
